verdict.rationale: Warp exposes some programmatic surfaces — an Oz CLI for running/managing agents from scripts or CI (warp-docs-22/37/52), a documented settings file for 'programmatic control' (warp-docs-40), and a live openapi.json endpoint plus 'API, CLI, SDK, MCP' platform claim (warp-docs-42, warp-probe-2) — and the agent itself can run/control terminal apps (warp-docs-16/32). However, there is no explicit documentation of a control protocol for creating/managing panes or reading raw terminal output programmatically from an external driver. Missing for 10: a documented pane/window control API, explicit read/write terminal I/O protocol spec, and independent hands-on confirmation of external programmatic terminal control.
